name: semver-xyz
description: The semver.xyz specification site and reference parser

scripts.deploy: vlt run build -w site && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name semver-xyz
scripts.deploy:preview: vlt run build -w site && wrangler pages deploy site/dist --project-name semver-xyz --branch preview
scripts.release: vlt run test -w packages/parser && vlt publish --workspace packages/parser --access public
